cookies.description:
Optional. Leave empty to download public posts and the posts of public profiles without signing in. Paste your own Instagram cookies in JSON format to also download age-restricted posts and the posts of private profiles your account follows. It is a secret input, so the Apify Console hides and encrypts it.

Format: [{"name":"sessionid","value":"...","domain":".instagram.com"}, ...]
cookies.title: Instagram Cookies (Optional)

maxPosts_per_username.description: Maximum number of posts to download per username (after the date and pinned-post filters below). Public profiles need no sign-in, however many posts you ask for; a private profile needs your cookies.
maxPosts_per_username.title: Max Posts Per Username

newerThan.description: Skip posts published before this date. Leave empty for no date filter. Must be a date from 2000-01-01 up to the day before the run. Applies to usernames only. The date is read from the post's id, so it can be off by up to a day.
newerThan.title: Only posts newer than

postUrls.description: Instagram post, reel or IGTV URLs to download. Accepts /p/, /reel/, /reels/, /tv/, and canonical username/p/shortcode formats. Duplicates are silently de-duplicated.
postUrls.title: Instagram Post URLs

skipPinnedPosts.description: Leave out the posts a profile has pinned to the top of its grid. Applies to usernames only. A pinned post that is also the newest post cannot be recognised and stays in.
skipPinnedPosts.title: Skip pinned posts

usernames.description: Usernames whose recent posts should be processed. Each entry can be a username (with or without @) or a profile link such as https://www.instagram.com/natgeo/.
usernames.title: Instagram Usernames or Profile Links
